text: What was the bell-rope put there for? — to give a way from the opening down to the bed
id: q.why_bell_rope=to give a way from the opening down to the bed
why: The story so far shows only that the dummy rope hangs from a hook above the ventilator with its tassel on the pillow. Nobody has suggested that it serves as a route or that anything travels through the opening, so this purpose anticipates Holmes's later solution.
